feature: An editing session, end to end, checked on every rotating check
summary: One scripted session now does a whole edit the way you get it in Next: it cuts a talking recording, adds a clip, a dissolve and a moving title, plays the edit while checking 30 frames for blanks, and exports the MP4. It runs in every rotating check. It also turned up a panel bug, now fixed: the right panel ran off the window whenever a document had captions.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The walk is Scripts/playtest/an-editing-session-walk.json and sets no flags.

try.do: Open a screen recording with somebody talking and wait for the captions to write themselves.
Put the playhead at 0:08 and press Command K, then at 0:04 and press Command K, then press Delete.
Drag a second recording onto the end of V1.
Click the recording, click the join the delete left, and pick Cross dissolve.
At 0:01 press T, click the picture, type a title, press Command Return, then click the Position diamond.
Step one second on and drag the title somewhere else on the canvas.
Press Home, then Space, and watch the whole edit play through.
Open Export, keep MP4, and export.

evaluate: Is this the session you would do yourself in a first sitting, or is something a Premiere editor does in every edit missing from it?
Once the captions are written, does the right panel now sit inside the window with nothing cut off on its right edge?
Does the caption Style bar spanning the whole panel, as the mock draws it, read better than when it sat beside a label?
After the cut, do the captions over the b-roll look as wrong to you as they do to me?
rough: The captions do not follow the cut: after Delete closes the gap they stay where they were, so lines play over the wrong words and over the b-roll. Filed as a p1 task (Cutting a stretch out of a recording takes its captions along). The walk does not claim this yet, so it stays green until that task adds the claim.
The Export sheet said about 9.6 MB and the MP4 came out at 693 KB. Filed as a p2 task.
On the jump cut the Edit point section's Spare before box is too narrow and shows '...' instead of 8.6s. Added to the transition placement task.
The Captions Generate row squeezes its button to 'Write Ag...' beside '10 captions'.
The blink check reads the picture the canvas is handed while it plays. It cannot see a blink that happens only on the screen after that point, such as a frame the window draws late.
